clips.title: The story
paras: Warlocks gather at the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore, drawing the scout Balthule Shadowstrike’s attention. He asks travelers to recover parchment scraps from the fanatics camped outside the ruins, hoping to learn who they are and what they seek.

Balthule Shadowstrike watches the misty shore of northern Darkshore, keeping sight of the ancient Tower of Althalaxx. Auberdine sent him to monitor the ruin and warn Delgren the Purifier if danger grew. But leaving his post to report might mean missing the dark spellcasters moving among the stones. So Balthule asks passing travelers to scout the camps around the tower.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A group of warlocks has taken up residence around and inside the tower. I would have returned to Auberdine to report to Elissa earlier, but I was afraid that I might miss something while I was away.
Delgren suspected such a company might be gathering at the tower, but did not know why.
A few scraps of parchment that the warlocks carry have found their way to my hands, but I need more to complete the puzzle. I warn you not to venture into
The tower, however, the warlocks there are much more powerful!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found any more of their scrolls? I should be able to piece together a larger picture of the cult if you can find them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Many thanks, friend. This should shed some light on this warlocks' gathering...
Hmm... The Cult of the Dark Strand... I have never heard of this group before. Having no knowledge of their history, it is all but impossible to say what their plans must be.
There is no more time to delay. Warning must be delivered to Delgren immediately.
